title: Andromeda before Photoshop
explanation:
# Andromeda Galaxy Revealed

This stunning portrait of Andromeda, our nearest galactic neighbor 2.5 million light-years away, is actually a composite of 223 deep exposures totaling over 18 hours of imaging from a Portuguese backyard observatory—carefully cleaned of airplane trails, satellite streaks, and camera glitches to reveal what our eyes would truly see if we could gather that much light. Rather than creating a digital fantasy, astronomers used specialized software to strip away Earth's atmospheric interference and technological pollution, leaving behind the authentic spiral structure and delicate dust lanes that make Andromeda one of the most massive galaxies in our cosmic neighborhood.
